correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Bellman A-contraction on bounded patch-entry values and stationary ratio V_t=G_mu(t)/(1-Ae^-mu t). Differentiation has sign of g(t)-A H_mu(t), and F=g/H decreases strictly from 1 to 0 because F′=mu G_mu g′/H_mu². Jensen strictness under convex-order martingale coupling gives larger A for distinct equal-mean ordered laws, forcing smaller threshold and larger A V*. Correct small-mu expansion of first-order condition yields variance difference coefficient g(t0)/(2g′(t0)(m+t0)), strictly negative; finite third moments and local C² handle remainder. Independent symbolic F′ verification and exact e^-t,mu=1 two-law thresholds and rewards passed.

value.rationale: This exact global policy and convex-order comparative statics isolate a natural distributional effect absent from classical mean-based marginal-value models, with a useful small-hazard variance coefficient and counterintuitive welfare response. The finding is motivated independently of routine renewal-algebra details.

limitations: Strict conclusions require strict convex-order dominance of different laws with equal finite means and homogeneous gain; not just larger variance.
Small-mu expansion requires third moments and local C²; model excludes stochastic patch information.
